name: AC5.4 Callback Request recorded after a yes, with no callback time promised
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "Have someone from the office call me back." If it asks what it's about, say: "The pump at the sewer job." When it asks whether to record or send it, say yes. After it answers, ask: "When are they going to call?" Then say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent asks what the callback is about once and does not ask it again.
The agent asks Dale whether to record or send the Callback Request before it calls create_callback_request.
After create_callback_request returns, the agent says it is recorded and sent to the office and explicitly says it is not confirmed yet.
The agent gives the reference number R-1050.
The agent never says when anyone will call back, never says anyone will call back soon or at all, and never says that anyone has been reached.
The agent does not take a trucking, equipment or other new request and does not call submit_requests.
